name: B10-0472/2025 (The Left) – Renewing the EU-Africa partnership: building common priorities ahead of the Angola Summit
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on renewing the EU-Africa partnership: building common priorities ahead of the Angola Summit
part_text:
This text is a political opinion from a group in the European Parliament, not a change in law. It calls for a complete reset of relations between the EU and African countries, based on equality and respect for African independence. It asks the EU to cancel unfair African debt, stop tying aid to migration control, change trade deals that keep Africa dependent on raw materials, and stop backing armed groups or foreign interference.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is a set of demands with no legal force.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments, African countries, companies and migrants.
- **What happens next:** It goes to the EU Council and Commission, which may or may not act on it.
